title: 5 cyclic cube fields with weight-conditioned admission

claims.statement: The explicit 5-field degree-200 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-40 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 27924093273697847/500000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=198035320630450629488877075979200237220797704196865810414447504325438624 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(236843/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), orbit count, nominal tails, field and operation bound (1), auxiliary child tails (2), and weighted admission and occupancy (3).
